# Thurgood Marshall College at UC San Diego

> > Thurgood Marshall College at UC San Diego, dedicated to social justice and diversity through the Dimensions of Culture (DOC) program and community-engaged learning.

Marshall College is one of UC San Diego's undergraduate colleges, offering the distinctive Dimensions of Culture general education sequence, Public Service Minor, and HBCU exchange opportunities. The college emphasizes social justice, cultural awareness, and community engagement rooted in its Lumumba-Zapata heritage.

## Dimensions of Culture (DOC) Program

- [DOC 3: Imagination + Action](http://marshall.ucsd.edu/doc/doc3/index.html): DOC 3 spring quarter course on research writing and social justice
- [Upper-Division DOC Courses](http://marshall.ucsd.edu/doc/upper-division-doc-courses.html): DOC 100D upper-division course info for diversity, equity & inclusion
- [DOC Faculty Biographies](http://marshall.ucsd.edu/doc/people/faculty-bios.html): DOC Program faculty bios including Dr. Amanda Solomon Amorao
- [DOC Teaching Assistants](http://marshall.ucsd.edu/doc/people/teaching-assistants.html): Roster of Dimensions of Culture Program graduate teaching assistants
